rows.prior_nonimplementation_reason: Previous productive bridge restricted to sound Form-I stems and lacked weak-final identity, realized-vowel and suffix contracts.
rows.implemented_scope: Conditional weak-final 2MS imperative deletion on retained symbolic stem, w/u or y/i and open-vowel branch; other subjects and suffixes blocked.
rows.residuals: Weak imperative persons beyond2MS; derivation of the pre-deletion stem from free text; subsequent phonological pause

rows.prior_nonimplementation_reason: Deleting a surface nun loses distinct nun identities, deleted subject markers, mood markers, source dialect profiles and analogy rank.
rows.implemented_scope: Eight structural profiles; light nun alif replacement, glide/mood-nun restoration, connected onset deletion; Khalil/Yunus alternatives and analogy provenance preserved.
rows.residuals: Yunus indicative-dual extension; full heavy/feminine nun grammar; free-text acquisition of subject and mood

rows.prior_nonimplementation_reason: Prior boundary catalogue lacked pronoun analysis and would conflate nominal ana/an with masdariyya particle.
rows.implemented_scope: Majority connected fatha and pausal alif, reported minority connected sukun, explicit unknown minority pause.
rows.residuals: Minority pause; every pronoun dialect; automatic pronoun/particle disambiguation
